source.snippet: The open source DOCX editor submitted to HN a few weeks ago has been deleted. The github repo under eigenpal is gone. The web site at docx-editor is 503. No idea what's going on. [81 points, 38 comments]

problem_statement: There is no reliable, self-hostable or open-source DOCX editor that individuals and small teams can depend on — existing tools disappear, go offline, or lack basic functionality, leaving users without a trustworthy alternative to Microsoft Word for collaborative document editing.
target_segment: Freelancers, small teams, and indie developers who need a dependable lightweight DOCX editor without a Microsoft 365 subscription
notes: 81 points and 38 comments on HN for a disappeared DOCX editor signals strong unmet demand. Users are frustrated that existing open-source options are unreliable. Buyer signal: people avoiding Microsoft 365 subscriptions (~$100–$360/year per user) represent clear willingness to pay for a stable alternative. A hosted SaaS DOCX editor with a freemium or low monthly fee could capture this segment.
